item.title: Infant Manikin
item.description: Infant Manikins, aka pediatric manikins or infant patient simulators, are life-like patient simulators that represent the body of a newborn patient. These products are known to offer effective infant cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) training without compromising realism or quality.
